question: Who among the following composed the National Song of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay** composed the National Song of India, "Vande Mataram".
 
• The song was written in **Sanskrit** and is part of his famous novel, **Anandamath**, published in 1882.
 
• "**Vande Mataram**" played a vital role in the Indian independence movement, inspiring freedom fighters and promoting a sense of patriotism.
 
• The first two verses of the song were adopted as the **National Song** of India on **January 24, 1950**, by the Constituent Assembly.
 
• The song is a tribute to the motherland, depicting the rich cultural heritage and beauty of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay** (1838-1894) was a renowned Bengali writer, poet, and journalist, and is considered one of the greatest novelists in Indian literature.
 
• He is also known for his other literary works, including "Kapalkundala", "Durgeshnandini", and "Krishnakanter Will".
 
• Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay was honored with the title of **Rajarshi** by the British government in recognition of his literary contributions.
 
• His works continue to inspire and influence Indian literature and culture.
 
• "**Vande Mataram**" was set to music by **Rabindranath Tagore**, the first Asian Nobel laureate.
